purpose: step2 fixed-plan conditional net-return development experiment
prior_exposure: Different evaluation quarters from rolling-price-v1, but historical ranking research may have exposed them; not final untouched test
horizon: Buy valid on T only; T+1 settlement; exit no later than T+4 if observable and tradable under scenario assumptions
features: 27 existing signal-close features; one model per plan and target; no market or industry additions in this contrast
calibration: Date-weighted sigmoid probability recalibration; date-weighted mean residual correction for return/downside, fitted only on calibration; retain raw versus calibrated predictions
label_policy: Unknown fill or return stays missing; known unfilled order has zero order return but no conditional filled-return label; daily stop-target ambiguity excluded from main mean/risk labels and separately reported with conservative stop-first stress results
missingness: Conditional mean pertains to resolved non-ambiguous fills, not all fills; resolution prediction is reported separately. Unknown results cannot be silently assigned the learned resolved-fill mean
primary_evaluation: All fixed stock-date-plan rows: fill Brier/log loss, resolution Brier/log loss, conditional return MAE/MSE and predicted-versus-realized bin means, loss probability Brier, downside MAE; report label coverage and date-block uncertainty
decision_diagnostic: Choose one plan by maximum calibrated fill_probability times conditional net return, requiring positive conditional return, fill_probability >= 0.3 and resolution_probability >= 0.9; this is a research score under resolved-fill assumptions, not unconditional expected return
baselines: Date-weighted per-plan training empirical heads under identical calibration; compare learned choice and empirical choice on common dates and report selection/unknown coverage
cost_stress: Double commission, minimum commission, tax and slippage; apply to unchanged chosen plans, preserving unknown states
promotion: No daily recommendation promotion. Existing price-quality gate remains failed. Any claimed benefit must include calibration, cross-window stability, nontrivial selection coverage, unknown outcomes and stress costs
uncertainty: 2000 circular two-date block bootstraps within fixed evaluation windows; calibrated learned minus calibrated empirical Brier/MSE; not IID-stock significance
